grammar.q: I wanted to know ____ it would rain this afternoon. So, I checked the weather report.
grammar.tip: 想知道「是否」會下雨 → if / whether

grammar.q: Please let me know what ____ to make a sandwich.
grammar.tip: what 當主詞，被需要 → is needed

grammar.q: Ben didn't know ____. Could you help him?
grammar.tip: wh- 不定詞：how to do it；間接問句不倒裝

grammar.q: Vic wasn't sure ____ the money.
grammar.tip: who 當主詞，語序不變：who took

grammar.q: I'm not sure ____ Tim will go to work tomorrow.
grammar.tip: 不確定「是否」→ whether

grammar.q: Harry didn't know ____ his homework, so he asked Jimmy for help.
grammar.tip: 不知如何做 → how to do（wh- + to V）

grammar.q: I have no idea ____ Judy didn't go to school.
grammar.tip: 不知道她「為什麼」沒上學 → why

grammar.q: Ben has no idea ____ with his sports car.
grammar.tip: what 當主詞：what's wrong with

grammar.q: My mom and I talked ____.
o: about what to eat for dinner
about where will we eat dinner
grammar.tip: talk about + 名詞片語；wh- + to V

grammar.q: My brother didn't tell me ____ in the box.
grammar.tip: what 當主詞：what was in the box

grammar.q: My mom has no idea ____ my dad will get home because he left his smartphone at home.
grammar.tip: 不知爸爸「何時」到家 → when

grammar.q: Amanda didn't know ____, so she googled it.
grammar.tip: 間接問句：wh- + 主詞 + 動詞

grammar.q: No one knows ____ will happen tomorrow, so let's live in the present.
grammar.tip: what 當子句主詞：what will happen

grammar.q: I have no idea ____ Alice works for, but I guess her boss is Mr. Wang.
grammar.tip: work for 某人 → who（老闆是誰）

grammar.q: Ivan wants to know ____ Dylan doesn't have to spend a lot of time studying and still gets good grades.
grammar.tip: 想知道「原因」→ why

grammar.q: Bill hasn't decided whether ____ the notebook or not.
grammar.tip: whether + to V（是否要…）

grammar.q:
A: Could you show me ____ to the nearest metro station?
B: Sure. Go along this road for two blocks and turn right. It's on your right.
grammar.tip: 問路：how to get to…

grammar.q: Monica was not sure ____ her son turned off the fan, so she checked it again.
grammar.tip: 不確定「是否」關了 → if

grammar.q: I went to bed early last night, so I didn't know ____ my sister got home.
grammar.tip: 早睡所以不知「何時」回家 → when

grammar.q: Does anybody know ____ Judy ____ to the party tonight?
grammar.tip: 名詞子句表未來仍用 will

grammar.q:
A: I don't know ____ with my life.
B: Just listen to your heart, and it will show you the way.
grammar.tip: do 需要受詞 → what to do

grammar.q: Tina and Kevin want to know when ____ to the bus station.
grammar.tip: 間接問句不倒裝：when they should go

grammar.q: I don't care ____. The point is that she didn't finish the work on time.
grammar.tip: 間接問句：what + 主詞 + 動詞

grammar.q: Vera went out very early this morning. I'm not sure ____ she had breakfast or not.
grammar.tip: …or not → if / whether（是否）

grammar.q: I have no idea ____ you love spiders so much.
grammar.tip: 不知「為什麼」喜歡 → why

grammar.q: I don't know where ____ the latest smartphone.
grammar.tip: wh- 不定詞：where to get

grammar.q: Tell me ____ Dennis brushed his teeth before he went to bed.
grammar.tip: 問「是否」刷牙 → whether

grammar.q: Can you tell me ____ Ivan? He looks worried.
grammar.tip: what's wrong with + 人（某人怎麼了）

grammar.q:
A: Judy is not sure ____ get to the small town.
B: Maybe she can take a taxi there.
grammar.tip: how to + 原形動詞

grammar.q: Nathan doesn't know why ____.
grammar.tip: 間接問句不倒裝：why + 主詞 + 動詞

grammar.q: I'll always remember ____.
o: what did he say to me
grammar.tip: how + 形容詞 + 主詞 + be

grammar.q:
A: Can you show me ____?
B: Sure, no problem.
o: how do you play the game
grammar.tip: show me how to + V

grammar.q: I'm not sure ____ I can go to Joyce's birthday party.
grammar.tip: 不確定「是否」能去 → if

grammar.q: Mrs. Wu wants to know ____ the toys are made in China or not.
grammar.tip: whether…or not（是否）

grammar.q: My aunt didn't remember ____ she parked her car, so she spent two hours looking for it.
grammar.tip: 找車 → 忘了停在「哪裡」where

grammar.q: Dad, I don't know ____ to do my math homework. Can you help me?
grammar.tip: 已有受詞 homework → how to

grammar.q: Could you tell me ____?
o: what does Andy like to eat
where did Andy go last night
grammar.tip: 間接問句語序：wh- + 主詞 + 動詞

grammar.q: My mom had no idea ____ for dinner, so we decided to eat out.
grammar.tip: wh- 不定詞：what to cook

grammar.q:
A: You are late. What took you so long?
B: I couldn't decide ____ wear a dress or not.
grammar.tip: whether + 主詞 + should，不倒裝

grammar.q: Sorry, I don't quite understand ____. Can you explain it to me?
grammar.tip: 間接問句：what you said

grammar.q:
A: Who is the man outside the classroom?
B: I'm not sure ____.
grammar.tip: Who is he? → who he is

grammar.q: We will give Ann a surprise when she ____ home. However, we don't know when she ____ home.
grammar.tip: 時間副詞子句用現在式；名詞子句保留 will

grammar.q: Whether it ____ or not, we will have the party.
grammar.tip: Whether…or not 表「無論」，現在式代未來

fix.t: Before she [[asked]] about it, you [[should tell]] Daphne you [[broke]] her favorite cup.
fix.tip: Before 時間副詞子句說未來的事，用現在式代替未來 → asks

fix.t: Tonight I'll [[stay]] at the office until I [[will finish]] the work. Then I'll [[drive]] home.
fix.tip: until 引導時間副詞子句，用現在式代替未來，不用 will

fix.t:
Jill: [[Have you decided]] [[where]] you will celebrate your 30th birthday?
Sue: Yeah, [[I'm going to have]] a big barbecue party.
fix.tip: 回答「辦烤肉派對」是慶祝的方式 → how，不是地點

fix.t: Alan [[works hard]] in his new job, and he [[wants]] to know [[that]] his boss feels about him.
fix.tip: know 後接疑問的名詞子句；feel about 某人要問「如何」→ how

fix.t: John [[will stay]] with his sister [[until]] he [[will find]] an apartment.
fix.tip: until 時間副詞子句用現在式代替未來 → finds

fix.t: If we [[play]] some interesting games in class, there [[will have]] more fun [[in learning]] English.
fix.tip: 「有」要用 there be，不可用 there have → will be

fix.t: Jerry [[wanted to know]] [[whether]] he was kicked off the soccer team, but no one [[gave]] him a good reason.
fix.tip: 後文說沒人給他「理由」→ 想知道為什麼 why

fix.t: We are surprised that Sally and Ray [[decided to get]] married. No one knows [[when]]. They often fight [[with each other]] and are unhappy together.
fix.tip: 兩人常吵架卻要結婚，沒人知道「原因」→ why

fix.t:
Alice: Do you know [[whether]] Grandma [[is going to visit]] us?
Willy: It's next week. She [[told me]] on the phone. And we'll take her to the national park.
fix.tip: 回答 It's next week 是時間 → 問 when

fix.t: I [[have to give]] Mr. Lin this letter. Could you [[tell me]] where [[does he live]]?
fix.tip: 間接問句不倒裝、去掉 does：where he lives

fix.t: This math problem is so hard. I don't know [[what to do]] it. Can you [[help]] me? I [[have tried]] three times.
fix.tip: do it 已有受詞 it，不能再用 what → how to do it

fix.t: [[If]] Tom will join us or not [[is]] not important. We [[will go]] anyway.
fix.tip: 名詞子句當主詞放句首只能用 Whether，不可用 If

fix.t: I wonder if it [[rains]] tomorrow. If it [[does]], we'll [[stay]] home.
fix.tip: wonder if 是名詞子句（是否），未來要用 will；條件句才用現在式

fix.t:
A: Who is the tall boy [[next to]] Amy?
B: Sorry, I [[have no idea]] [[who is he]].
fix.tip: 間接問句 be 動詞移到主詞後：who he is

fix.t: You look upset. Please tell me [[what did he say]] to you [[at]] the party. Did he [[make]] you angry?
fix.tip: 間接問句去掉 did，動詞改過去式：what he said

fix.t: Mom asked me [[why to be]] late, but I [[didn't tell]] her [[the truth]].
fix.tip: why 沒有不定詞用法；asked 過去 → why I was late

fix.t: We [[talked]] about [[if]] we should go camping [[this weekend]].
fix.tip: 介系詞 about 後面的「是否」只能用 whether，不用 if

fix.t: I don't know [[when]] Dad will come back. [[When]] he [[will come]] back, I'll give him the card.
fix.tip: 第二個 When 是時間副詞子句，用現在式代未來 → comes

fix.t: Do you know [[what time is it]]? My watch [[stopped]] and I [[don't want to]] be late.
fix.tip: 間接問句不倒裝：what time it is

fix.t: Could you [[show me]] [[how can I get]] to the train station? I'm [[new]] here.
fix.tip: 間接問句不可倒裝；show me how to get…

fix.t: I [[want to buy]] a gift [[for]] Helen, but I don't know [[what she like]].
fix.tip: 主詞 she 第三人稱單數，動詞加 s：what she likes

fix.t: [[Nobody]] knows [[if]] the singer [[comes]] to Taiwan next month.
fix.tip: if 子句當 knows 的受詞（是否），未來的事要用 will come

fix.t: This red bike [[has been]] parked here [[for]] days. Do you know [[whose bike is it]]?
fix.tip: 間接問句 be 動詞放主詞後：whose bike it is
